description: Use when someone wants to find a person to make, print, build, repair or customise something: a 3D print or replacement part, a cosplay costume or prop, miniatures or miniature painting, CNC or laser work, woodwork, sewing, metalwork and more. Searches independent makers on The Spool List by skill, machine, material, name or shop, optionally near a country or city. Returns name, handle, city and country, jobs completed, materials and a profile link.

city.description: City name to narrow results, e.g. "Austin".

country.description: Country to narrow results: ISO code or English name, e.g. "US", "GB", "Mexico".

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "resin miniatures", "PETG", "cosplay armor", or a maker name.

name: search_makers
title: Search makers
